name: Page
use: a full page that owns the whole phone: the task's own list, its overview, a form, a record log, an end review or a receipt
notUse: a quick action on one row (use the drawer), or a yes/no question (use the dialog)

name: Drawer
use: work on one sow or litter over the task list, with Back returning to the list: finish, record dead, count, sow death
notUse: a whole-task view or anything that needs the list hidden

name: Dialog
use: one question over a drawer: choose what changed, then apply
